title: Recurrence for the input chain
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $w$ be a binary input, with $t,p\in\mathbb N$. The input-chain value at position $p$ after $t$ steps equals the input symbol at position $p$ if the input head is at position $p$; otherwise it is empty when $p=0$, and for $p>0$ it equals the input-chain value at position $p-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state multi-tape Turing machine M over the binary alphabet
